agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has single free circle (r=1.13) starting at x=15.4 moving right at vx=8.88 with gravity 9.81 and no walls. No horizontal forces or boundary collision response is applied (vx constant across steps), so the body drifts ballistically past the right arena edge. At step 68 x=18.996 -> right edge 20.127 (overshoot 0.127 <0.15) and at step 69 x=19.049 -> right edge 20.180 (overshoot 0.179 >0.15), triggering in_arena. Reducing initial vx is sufficient to keep the body inside for the same 69 steps, confirming the unbounded horizontal coasting is the cause.
